title: Glenn Miller's Last Flight
hook: Why did the big band leader disappear over the Atlantic?
headline: The bandleader lost in the sky

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On 15 December 1944, Glenn Miller boarded a USAAF transport in England.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The aircraft vanished near the coast of Dover, with no radio distress.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Witnesses on a nearby ship reported seeing a flash and then silence.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2019, sonar found a wreck matching Miller's plane, but identification stays disputed.

end.line: What really happened to the missing big band leader?

description: Explore the mystery of Glenn Miller's disappearance over the Atlantic in 1944.

facts.claim: Glenn Miller boarded a USAAF C-47 transport in England on 15 December 1944.
The aircraft disappeared over the English Channel near Dover with no distress signal.
A British ship reported seeing a flash of light at the time of disappearance.
A 2019 sonar survey located a wreck consistent with a C-47 near the Channel.
Identification of the wreck remains disputed among researchers.
